title: Decision Tree Classifier (CART)
signature: def decision_tree_predict(X_train: np.ndarray, y_train: np.ndarray, X_test: np.ndarray, max_depth: int, min_samples_split: int = 2) -> np.ndarray
hints: Write best_split(X, y) first (see the Gini best-split problem), then build the tree recursively on index subsets.
Check the stopping rules before searching for a split: depth == max_depth, fewer than min_samples_split samples, a pure node, or no candidate threshold.
A node can be stored as a tuple: ('leaf', label) or ('split', j, t, left, right). Route a test point left when x[j] <= t.
A leaf predicts its majority label. np.bincount(labels).argmax() already breaks ties toward the smallest label.
